description: The decoded event carries both a totalAmount (what was paid in, before a hypothetical 2% broker fee) and the real depositAmount (what actually got locked, after fees). Capacity must equal depositAmount exactly and must never equal totalAmount. This is the only fixture where totalAmount is present at all -- the model has no field that reads it.
note: Real Gate 1 depositAmount (100,000 * 1e18). totalAmount is a synthetic 102,000 * 1e18 standing in for a hypothetical 2% broker fee -- the real Gate 1 stream had no broker fee, so this specific totalAmount value does not correspond to anything on-chain.
